page.overview:
What is Gemini?

Gemini, also known as One, is one of the main deuteragonists and true main antagonists in Bobbiedots, Part 1 and Bobbiedots, Part 2 in the fourth and fifth books from the Tales from the Pizzaplex series.

Gemini is one of the second-generation (also known as gen2) Bobbiedots in the Fazplex Tower. In Abe's apartment, she is in charge of entertainment and media.

Like the other Bobbiedots, Gemini is a holographic girl with gray skin, a large heart-shaped face, arched brows, a large oval spot on her forehead, a large circle on top of her head, and a small protrusion for nose. Her dominant color is bright blue. Gemini's bright blue pigtails resemble streams of light more than actual hair, and her ears are covered in a set of headphones featuring upright antennae that end in glowing little blue circles. She’s as slender as Olive. Gemini has unnaturally large, bright blue, catlike eyes, blue bow-shaped lips, and glowing blue fingertips. She also wears a gray-and-white bell-bottomed bodysuit striped bright blue.

Gemini is shown to be very energetic and has a passion for entertainment and music, with her always suggesting and putting on music whenever Abe is hurt or sad. She is also shown to have a liking to Abe, but it is unknown if it is genuine or just part of her programming.
